reason: Reproduced by driving the master (chromium, state=owner-flight, editor opened from a row's Edit chip). Every number in the finding is exact. Below 1280 .b-edit is fixed left:12/right:12 and nothing inside is capped: .b-input measures 1221px at 1279, 1094 at 1152, 710 at 768, 332 at 390 - a date field holding '1 August 2026' drawn 1221px across. .b-seg measures 1221x39 at 1279 while its two buttons measure 70.1px and 72.1px, so the Shown/Hidden plate is a bordered box with 142px of control at its left end and ~1079px of empty framed nothing to its right; same at 768 (710 box, 142px of buttons) and still ~190px of dead frame at 390. .b-stepBtns, .b-editActs and the reversibility bar all span 1221 too; 'Done' is 61.1px and 'Delete this moment' 156.6px, both stranded at the left of a 1255x557 slab (70% of an 800px viewport). At 1280+ the same panel is 344px and reads correctly, so it is a band-only failure. Not a gate restatement: interaction-check.mjs asserts nothing about editor content widths (its 'measure' assertions are about the timeline, not typographic measure), and audit.mjs covers palette/weights/contrast/hit targets/radii/motion/ramp. Not taste: it is the documented lessons.md class 'the measure has a floor AND a ceiling ... broken at a width nobody screenshotted' creeping back. One correction to the finding, which strengthens it rather than weakens it: the band WAS screenshotted - approach-owner-editing--1279x800.png ships the 1221px date field and the empty segmented plate in the frame set, so this is visible in the delivered evidence. The finding's proposed .b-seg rule is mechanically wrong, though: .b-seg is already display:inline-flex (b.css:758) and width:auto changes nothing, because .b-seg is a grid item of a display:grid parent, which blockifies inline-flex to flex and stretches it via the default justify-self:stretch. Fix corrected below. Palette, weights and architecture are untouched by the fix.
sharpenedFix: In the @media (max-width: 1279px) block only, give the sheet's contents a measure and let the segmented plate shrink-wrap: (1) .b-edit { justify-items: start } plus .b-edit > * , .b-edit .b-undo { max-width: 480px; width: 100% } - the width:100% keeps the fields filling the capped column once justify-items is start, and .b-undo needs its own rule because it is absolutely positioned by left/right:16px, so cap it with right:auto; width:min(480px, calc(100% - 32px)) instead of max-width alone. (2) .b-edit .b-seg { justify-self: start; width: auto } - justify-self is the property that actually stops the grid stretch; leave the existing display:inline-flex alone. Do NOT touch .b-edit's own inset - the docked full-bleed edge is correct and the reservation logic (--b-sheet padding, scroll-padding-bottom, the bottom:76px undo offset) depends on it. Re-shoot approach-owner-editing at 768, 1152 and 1279 after the change, since the current frames at those widths carry the defect.
